title: campus-half landing floor hardcodes the literal 10 instead of deriving from the catalog like EXPECTED
evidence:
testing.expectf(t, campus_window_spawns >= 10*WINDOW*95/100,
		"the campus half must land: in-window campus spawns %d < %d (10/tick × WINDOW × 0.95)", campus_window_spawns, 10*WINDOW*95/100)

	EXPECTED := i64(stream_entries) * i64(surge.multiplier) * i64(WINDOW) // 2×1×10×WINDOW = 20×WINDOW
detail: The same r3 fold made EXPECTED derive from the catalog (N5) so a re-tune cannot silently drift it, yet the campus floor restates `10` (= campus vol 1 × multiplier 10) as a literal, violating ODN-5's never-restated-numbers rule.
recommended_fix: Derive the campus floor from the campus entry's volume × surge.multiplier × WINDOW × 95/100, mirroring the EXPECTED loop, so a campus re-tune keeps both pins in lock-step.

title: usage() omits the new fold-check subcommand
evidence: fmt.eprintln("usage: harness run|save [demo...] [--stats-out <path>] | replay <demo> <log.bin> | drift-check | preview-check | stats-check <demo> | input-parity [save] | palcheck | map-preview <seed> [out.png]")
detail: The fold-check verb is wired into main.odin but the usage() string lists every other subcommand and not this one, so a no-arg or wrong-arity invocation prints help that hides the new gate.
recommended_fix: Append `| fold-check <prev-hash> <prev-tick1>` to the usage() string (and the overlay-check line pattern) so the CLI help stays complete.

title: fold_check hand-rolls boot's run setup, duplicating demos/boot.dem outside the Demo_Replay single-source path
evidence:
pp.run_init(&state, 42, cat.hash, cat.balance.logic_hz)
	state.era = 0
	seed_fixture(&state, &cat)
	before := len(state.events)
	pp.step(&state, 1, {}, &cat)
detail: The verifier re-implements boot's setup (seed 42, era 0, fixture, step 1) as literals rather than loading demos/boot.dem via load_demo_replay/demo_apply_setup — the codebase's own doctrine for preventing run-setup drift. A boot.dem change would silently invalidate the verdict.
recommended_fix: Derive the boot setup from demos/boot.dem (load_demo_replay + demo_apply_setup), or at minimum assert boot.dem's seed/fixture/command-less shape matches the hardcoded literals before splicing.
